reply.emotion: affectionate and warm, speaking softly to a pet
notes: In addition to the animal, 'gato' is commonly used in Mexico and other Spanish-speaking countries to mean a mechanical car jack used for changing tires.

senses.definition: Mamífero pequeño, carnívoro, de pelo suave, que se domestica a menudo como animal de compañía.

examples.text: El gato duerme todo el día en el sillón.
examples.translation: The cat sleeps all day on the armchair.
examples.emotion: cozy and relaxed, smiling at a sleeping pet

senses.definition: Herramienta portátil que sirve para levantar objetos pesados, como un coche para cambiar una rueda.

examples.text: Necesitamos sacar el gato del maletero para cambiar la llanta.
examples.translation: We need to take the jack out of the trunk to change the tire.
examples.emotion: practical and focused, trying to solve a roadside problem
